title: The Rees algebra of an ideal of a Noetherian ring is Noetherian
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal. Then the Rees algebra $\mathcal R_A(I)=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}I^nt^n\subseteq A[t]$ [def-nagata-rees-algebra], the subring of $A[t]$ consisting of the polynomials whose coefficient of $t^n$ lies in $I^n$ for every $n\ge0$, is a Noetherian ring.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 02OA (lemma-cohomology-powers-ideal-application), line 5502 ('As B is Noetherian'); the Rees algebra is Algebra, Definition 052Q (definition-blow-up, algebra.tex line 17143); it is generated over A by the degree-one elements f_it for generators f_1,...,f_r of I, hence Noetherian by Algebra, Lemma 00FN (lemma-Noetherian-permanence, algebra.tex line 5991).
